cities.name: Moscow
cities.local_food_tip: Russian comfort meals: soups, dumplings (veg versions exist), pies, salads and warm pastries — jednostavno i ukusno.
cities.full_day:
Morning: 🏛️ Red Square (Exterior). → 🎨 St. Basil’s Cathedral (Exterior). → ☕ GUM café break.

Afternoon: 🌿 Zaryadye Park views. → 🌊 Moskva River promenade. → 🍽️ Lunch: soups, potato dishes, salads. → 🏛️ Arbat Street (Exterior walk).

Sunset: 🌅 Sparrow Hills viewpoint.

Night: 🌃 City center lights + dessert stops.
public_transport_tips: 📱 Use 'Yandex Metro' or 'Yandex Maps' for navigation.

city_events.name: Moscow City Day
city_events.description: 🎉 Concerts, parades and cultural events downtown.

cities.name: Kaliningrad
